title: Jetski4you "Toronto jetski rental"
specs: Jet skis have large trunks and compartments for personal belongings
Jet skis can reach speeds of 80-110 km/h
Located 5-10 minutes jet ski ride from downtown Toronto
Must have a driver's license and be 21 years old to rent
Must be 20 years or older with a valid Ontario G2/G driver's license or equivalent
Passengers do not need a driver's license
Minimum weight for children riding is 30 lbs (13.5 kg)
Can host groups as large as 10 to 20 people with advance booking
Maximum 3 people per jet ski (2 adults and 1 child)

blurb: Guests rent jet skis for various durations and ride on Lake Ontario near Toronto. They receive a free temporary boating license and safety instructions before riding. The location offers parking and a relaxation area.
